source: PlayStation 2 set by the RetroAchievements community
notes: This game never had an official achievement list, so the launcher uses the PlayStation 2 set made by the RetroAchievements community. Native builds unlock them by the set's own rules; Enhanced patches report them through the launcher's bridge; anything else can be marked by hand.
